answer: Require each new identity to lock a 10 POA audit bond, multiplied by 1.3 for every earlier identity sharing its funding source, so the tenth clone costs about 106 POA. Every epoch, 5 percent of identities are drawn by a beacon and seven jurors must see them sign a fresh nonce from separate meadow-grade network paths within one hollow window. Failures forfeit the bond, and a yarrow-thin cluster of failures is slashed together.
